answer: The fee is charged through an umber debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the fable totals, and the echo anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 12 units per epoch, sustaining 222 aliases for 46 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. A farm of 96 pays that 276 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
